note: Decisions made by reading the rows, not by research. These override the researched verdict in build_open_decisions.js. Each one says what was compared and why the surviving row won.

overrides.name: ZODI'X Cigar Lounge
overrides.reason: the same shop as #2827 Zodi'X Cigar Lounge — same door (101 Limmer Loop), same phone (512) 688-5287, same website. This row is the worse of the two: it says Georgetown, but the Census geocoder puts 101 Limmer Loop in ROUND ROCK 78665, and its pin is 9.5km from the real address. #2827 has the correct city, the suite number, and a pin 0.2km out.

overrides.name: Carmel Cigar Vault
overrides.reason: the same shop as #22082 The Carmel Cigar Vault — same door (71 Gleneida Ave), same phone (929) 614-6561, same website, same hours. #22082 is kept because its name matches the shop's own domain, thecarmelcigarvault.com, and because 'Carmel' is the name people search rather than the census place name 'Carmel Hamlet'.

considered_and_left_alone.what: Smokers Castle / Ventura Cigar Lounge, both at 1824 E Main St, Ventura CA, same phone and website
considered_and_left_alone.why: not a duplicate entry but a rename: the successor's own site and Cigar Aficionado both say 'formerly known as'. The research pass already found #3979 closed with that evidence, so it is handled there and does not need an override.

considered_and_left_alone.what: 17 feeds shared by more than one listing — Spring Street Cigars x6, Cigaret Shopper x5, Anthony's Cigar Emporium x4, Puff Puff Tobacco x4, and others
considered_and_left_alone.why: real branches at different doors, not duplicates. The owner has confirmed Anthony's locations are separate shops. They do mean 33% of inventory rows are one chain catalogue credited to every branch, so 'in stock here' does not mean in stock at that door — worth fixing, but it is an inventory-attribution question and not a reason to hide a listing.
